verdict.rationale: Basecamp documents separate tools: card tables (board-like), to-do lists, a global calendar, and a timeline-style overview of project overlaps and dates. Nothing shows the same work items being switched between board, list, calendar and timeline views. These are distinct tools holding different content, which counts only as adjacent features, not a view-switching capability.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can switch between board, list, calendar, and timeline views of the same work
